headline: Carlson predicts a GOP wipeout; Vance won't disown him

beats.text: Number five. The Trump-Tucker Carlson feud, simmering since twenty twenty-five over foreign policy, kept boiling into September.

beats.caption: Republicans are definitely going to lose the House of Representatives.
beats.label: via Tucker Carlson, Sep 9 livestream

beats.text: In a video titled 'Trump Betrayed His Voters,' Carlson explained exactly why.

beats.caption: ...because he followed not their wishes, but the wishes of a foreign government.
beats.label: via Tucker Carlson, Sep 9 livestream

beats.text: Six days earlier, a reporter had put Vance on the spot.

beats.caption: Mr. Vice President, Tucker Carlson has called for the president's impeachment.
beats.label: via USA TODAY, Sep 3

beats.caption: Tucker is a friend of mine. Tucker is a friend despite the fact that we disagree on a number of things.
beats.label: via PBS NewsHour, Sep 3

beats.caption: And I'm not going to play the game where I throw friends under the bus.
beats.label: via USA TODAY, Sep 3

beats.text: So the second most powerful Republican in the country won't throw his buddy under the bus, even as that buddy predicts his own party is about to lose the midterms.
